title: Critical importance of DNA binding for CSL protein functions in fission yeast
authors: Anna Marešová; Martina Oravcová; Miluše Hradilová; Viacheslav Zemlianski; Robert Häsler; Martin Převorovský
one_liner_zh: 该文通过突变实验研究裂殖酵母CSL转录因子DNA结合对其功能的重要性，属于实验验证，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未涉及三维互作建模，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: CSL (CBF1/RBP-Jκ/Suppressor of Hairless/LAG-1) proteins are conserved transcription factors found in animals and fungi. In fission yeast, they regulate various cellular processes, including cell cycle progression, lipid metabolism, and cell adhesion. CSL proteins bind to DNA through their N-terminal Rel-like domain and central beta-trefoil domain. Here, we investigated the importance of DNA binding for CSL functions in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe . We created CSL mutants with disrupted DNA binding and found that the vast majority of CSL functions depend on intact DNA binding. Specifically, DNA binding is crucial for the regulation of cell adhesion, lipid metabolism, cell cycle progression, long non-coding RNA expression, and genome integrity maintenance. Interestingly, perturbed lipid metabolism leads to chromatin structure changes, potentially linking lipid metabolism to the diverse CSL-associated phenotypes. Our study highlights the critical role of DNA binding for CSL protein functions in fission yeast. SUMMARY STATEMENT CSL transcription factors regulate a diverse set of processes, but the mechanisms are not always clear. We show that S. pombe CSL proteins need the ability to bind DNA for most of their roles.
abstract_zh: CSL（CBF1/RBP-Jκ/Suppressor of Hairless/LAG-1）蛋白是在动物和真菌中保守的转录因子。在裂殖酵母中，它们调控多种细胞过程，包括细胞周期进程、脂质代谢和细胞黏附。CSL蛋白通过其N端Rel样结构域和中央β-三叶草结构域与DNA结合。在此，我们研究了DNA结合对裂殖酵母粟酒裂殖酵母（Schizosaccharomyces pombe）中CSL功能的重要性。我们创建了DNA结合被破坏的CSL突变体，并发现绝大多数CSL功能依赖于完整的DNA结合。具体而言，DNA结合对细胞黏附、脂质代谢、细胞周期进程、长链非编码RNA表达和基因组完整性维持的调控至关重要。有趣的是，脂质代谢的扰动导致染色质结构变化，这可能将脂质代谢与多种CSL相关表型联系起来。我们的研究强调了DNA结合对裂殖酵母中CSL蛋白功能的关键作用。摘要声明 CSL转录因子调控多种过程，但其机制并不总是清晰。我们表明，粟酒裂殖酵母CSL蛋白需要具备DNA结合能力以执行其大部分功能。
